n. A shockdog.

shouji.translation: n. 手机；正治（日本男子名）

should.definition:
imp. of Shall
imp. Used as an auxiliary verb, to express a conditional or
   contingent act or state, or as a supposition of an actual fact; also,
   to express moral obligation (see Shall); e. g.: they should have come
   last week; if I should go; I should think you could go.

shoulder.definition:
n. the part of the body between the neck and the upper arm
n. a cut of meat including the upper joint of the foreleg
n. a ball-and-socket joint between the head of the humerus and a cavity of the scapula
n. the part of a garment that covers or fits over the shoulder
shoulder.translation:
n. 肩, 肩膀, 衣肩
vt. 肩负, 负担, 担任
vi. 用肩推挤

shoulder bag.translation: n. 有肩带的女用手提包

shoulder belt.translation: n. 从肩上斜过胸部的肩带或饰带

shoulder joint.translation: n. 肩关节; 肩接; 臂关节

shoulder surfing.translation: n. 肩窥（越过肩膀探看别人操作获取信息的做法）

shoulder to shoulder.translation: 肩并肩地, 齐心协力地

shoulder-bags.translation: 有肩带的女用手提包（shoulder bag的名词复数）

shoulder-pads.translation: (shoulder-pad 的复数) n. （衣服的）垫肩

shoulder-pegged.translation: a. 肩膀僵直的, 马肩膀僵直的

shoulder-strap.translation: n. 肩带, 背带, 肩章

shoulder-straps.translation: n. 肩带, 背带；肩章

shoulder-to-shoulder.definition: r side by side and close together
shoulder-to-shoulder.translation: adv. 肩并肩地；齐心协力地

shoulder-widths.translation: (shoulder-width 的复数) 肩宽；路肩宽度

shouldered.definition: a. having shoulders or shoulders as specified; usually used as a combining form
shouldered.translation: a. 带凸肩的；肩膀…的（用以构成复合词）

v push with the shoulders
v carry a burden, either real or metaphoric
shouldering.translation: n. 碰撞驱舰, 撞舰驱赶；肩托

shout.definition:
v. utter in a loud voice; talk in a loud voice (usually denoting characteristic manner of speaking)
v. utter a sudden loud cry
shout.translation:
n. 呼喊, 喊声
vi. 呼喊, 喊叫, 嚷
vt. 高喊

shout at sb.translation: 对某人大声叫嚷, 向...叫喊

shout down.translation: 大声呼喊使不能继续讲下去

shout sb down.translation: 大声叫喊着压倒某人的声音, 比某人叫得响, 大叫大嚷使某人无法发言

shout song.translation: (领唱与会众应答喊唱的)宗教歌曲

shouted.translation: v. 呼, 喊, 叫( shout的过去式和过去分词 ); 大声讲

shouter.definition: n someone who communicates vocally in a very loud voice
shouter.translation: n. 高呼者, 喊叫者

shouters.definition:
plural of shouter
n someone who communicates vocally in a very loud voice
shouters.translation: (shouter 的复数) n. 高呼者, 喊叫者

shouting.definition:
n encouragement in the form of cheers from spectators
n uttering a loud inarticulate cry as of pain or excitement
v utter in a loud voice; talk in a loud voice (usually denoting characteristic manner of speaking)
v utter a sudden loud cry
v utter aloud; often with surprise, horror, or joy
v use foul or abusive language towards

shouting match.translation: n. 大声嚷嚷的争吵（或争论）

shouts.definition:
n a loud utterance; often in protest or opposition
v utter in a loud voice; talk in a loud voice (usually denoting characteristic manner of speaking)
v utter a sudden loud cry
v utter aloud; often with surprise, horror, or joy
v use foul or abusive language towards
shouts.translation:
n. 呼喊, 喊叫( shout的名词复数 ); 轮到请客
v. 呼, 喊, 叫( shout的第三人称单数 ); 大声讲

shouty.translation: 大喊大叫的；吵吵嚷嚷的
